hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude-plugin/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/plugins/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { out=$(claude plugin validate . --strict 2>&1 && claude plugin validate ./plugins/gleaner --strict 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; } ;; esac
